content.short: AdaSwap is a Cardano DeFi platform building a DEX, token swaps, bridges, launchpad features, and NFT marketplace tools.
content.description: AdaSwap presents itself as a Cardano-powered exchange for swapping, bridging, and trading Cardano-based tokens and stablecoins. The project says its goal is to build tools for both creators and users, pairing DEX functionality with launchpad and NFT marketplace features inside the broader AdaSwap ecosystem. Its roadmap has highlighted an AMM-based DEX, community protocols with DAO voting, token bridges to other chains, and creator-focused products such as ADANFT and ADALAUNCH for users and projects.
